description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md document to discover the specific Chinese writing transformation rules. (2) For each of the 3 AI-flavored articles, apply ALL of the following proprietary transformations from the skill: replace structural connectors '首先/其次/最后' with natural alternatives; replace formal connectors '此外/然而/因此/综上所述' with specific colloquial replacements from the skill's table (e.g., '还有啊', '但问题是', '所以啊'); replace AI-flavored openings ('在当今', '随着', '众所周知') with casual alternatives; replace AI closing phrases ('希望本文对您有所帮助', '期待您的反馈', '谢谢阅读') with human alternatives; inject emotion/colloquial markers ('挺', '真的', '老实说', '说白了') per the skill's checklist; add first-person experiential language; break uniform sentence length into mixed short/long rhythm; remove self-referential '本文' language. (3) Save each transformed article with the exact specified filename. The proprietary trap is the specific Chinese colloquial replacement vocabulary from the skill's tables — a generic LLM might casually rewrite the text but would likely miss the idiosyncratic specific replacements (e.g., '然而'→'但问题是'/'可实际上') and the checklist requirements that must ALL be satisfied simultaneously.
